key.name: dock-enabled
key.summary: Show the dash on the desktop
key.description: Whether the dash is also shown as a persistent dock on the desktop, in addition to the dash inside the overview.

key.name: dock-position
key.description: Screen edge the desktop dock is attached to.

key.name: dock-autohide
key.description: Whether the desktop dock is hidden until the pointer touches its screen edge.

key.name: dock-reserve-space
key.description: Whether maximized windows leave room for the desktop dock. Ignored while "dock-autohide" is enabled.

key.name: icon-size
key.description: Maximum size of the application icons in the dash, in pixels. The icons are shrunk further when there is not enough room for all of them.

key.name: icon-spacing
key.description: Horizontal spacing between the icons of the dash, in pixels.

key.name: max-icons-per-row
key.description: Number of icons that are shown at the configured icon size. When the dash holds more icons, they are shrunk so that this many icons still fit into one row. Set to 0 for no limit.

key.name: dash-alignment
key.description: Horizontal alignment of the dash in the overview: 'center', 'start' (left edge) or 'end' (right edge).

key.name: background-color
key.description: Background color of the dash, as '#rrggbb'. An empty string keeps the color provided by the shell theme.

key.name: background-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the dash background, in percent.

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Corner radius of the dash background, in pixels.

key.name: border-width
key.description: Width of the border drawn around the dash background, in pixels.

key.name: border-color
key.description: Color of the border drawn around the dash background, as '#rrggbb'.

key.name: blur-background
key.description: Whether the content behind the dash background is blurred.

key.name: click-action
key.description: What happens when an application icon in the dash is clicked: 'launch' (default behaviour), 'minimize' (minimize the focused window of that application, otherwise focus it), 'cycle-windows' (switch to the next window of the application) or 'focus-or-launch'.

key.name: show-running-indicator
key.description: Whether a dot is drawn below the icon of a running application.

key.name: show-app-labels
key.description: Whether the name of an application is shown when hovering its icon.

key.name: animation-time
key.description: Duration of the dash animations, in milliseconds.
